note: Adapted from Hill's (1942) new-species description, the original in English; the heading reads Calotermes (subgen. ?) pallidinotum sp. nov., now placed in Kalotermes. Measurements in mm. Distribution: Pigeon House Range, New South Wales (type locality) and other localities. OCR problems: the figures are cited as '(Figs. 63 and 61+)', which should be 63 and 64; '3nd' and 'sth' are misreadings of 3rd and 5th; in the soldier antennal formula '4th - Bth progressively longer' the Bth should be 8th; the soldier head width 0.84—1.32 is an unusually wide span, one end is suspected to be an OCR error (not determinable), and the original is transcribed as it stands.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head, abdominal tergites and apical sternites dark brown; mesonotum, metanotum, the remaining sternites and the wings slightly paler; pronotum and labrum yellow-brown; legs, antennae and palpi pale brown, the femora tinged with a deeper brown, the tibiae sometimes yellow-brown. Head (Fig. 63) very small, the sides nearly parallel, sparsely hairy. Frons with a fairly large concavity. Anteclypeus strongly arched in the middle. Compound eyes small (diameter 0.22—0.24). Ocelli very small and very close to the compound eyes. Antennae 13- or 14-segmented, usually 14; segment 1 short, narrow, subcylindrical; segment 2 about one quarter narrower than segment 1, usually as long as segments 3 and 4; segment 3 sometimes shorter than segments 2 and 4; the remaining segments globose, the second segment from the front gradually longer, the terminal segment the same as segment 5. Pronotum with inconspicuous marginal impressions, sparsely covered with short hairs, as wide as the head, rarely wider, the anterior margin slightly concave, or straight, or convex, often with a fairly deep median concavity, the sides slightly rounded, the posterolateral angles rounded or faintly oblique, the posterior margin with a wide median concavity. Wings narrow, the costa absent; subcosta of the forewing degenerate or short; radius single, about twice as long as the width of the wing at the suture; radial sector with 6—8 branches; media parallel to the radial sector, equidistant from the radial sector and the cubitus, or less than its width nearer the former than the latter, sometimes forked at the apex, the anterior branch sometimes connected with the radial sector; cubitus running through the middle of the wing, with about 12 branches. Measurements (mm): body length with wings 7.60—8.00; body length without wings 5.00; head length (to apex of labrum) 1.02—1.08; head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 0.75—0.80; head width 0.91; pronotum length 0.55—0.60; pronotum width 0.91—0.95; forewing length 5.25—5.80; forewing width 1.60—1.78.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: A small species, the head long and very narrow. Posterior part of the head dark orange-yellow, gradually becoming dark ferruginous or brown anteriorly; labrum pale yellow; mandibles dark chestnut at the base, gradually becoming almost black towards the apex; antennae and pronotum the same colour as the base of the head. Frons slightly concave, shining, the anterior dorsal margin often with faint wrinkles and/or a wide, very inconspicuous median concavity (Fig. 64). Labrum large, obtusely conical, sometimes with the anterior margin concave, the margins impressed. Compound eyes moderate in size, sometimes partly pigmented. Ocelli very small but distinct. Sutures distinct. Postmentum long, very narrow in the middle. Mandibular teeth sharp, directed forwards, the 2 teeth of the right mandible situated nearer the base, the 3 teeth of the left mandible equidistant, the hindmost tooth smallest. Antennae 10—13-segmented, rarely 10; segment 3 often very small and closely fused with segment 4; segment 4 slightly longer than segment 3 and more globose; segments 4—8 gradually longer. Pronotum narrower than the head, the anterior margin slightly raised and with a wide angular concavity, the sides nearly straight, narrowed posteriorly, the posterolateral angles faintly oblique or rounded, the posterior margin broadly rounded, or faintly emarginate, or widely concave, or nearly straight in the middle; mesonotum and metanotum with short wing buds. Legs short and stout. Measurements (mm): body length 4.60—5.70; head length including mandibles 2.01—2.34; head length (to clypeal suture) 1.46—1.83; head width 0.84—1.32; postmentum width at its narrowest 0.14—0.18; pronotum length 0.44—0.58; pronotum width 0.73—0.95.
